'''Lank Paze''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served in [[First Order Navy|the naval forces]] of the [[First Order]]. Holding the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[Petty Officer]], he was part of [[General]] [[Armitage Hux]]'s staff.<ref name="TLJ:TVD" /> He reported the transmission of [[Poe Dameron]] to Hux. His [[Rank insignia of the First Order|commemorative armband]] read "[[Hal (Imperial officer)|Hal]],"<ref name="Episode VIII" /> designating him as [[squad leader]].<ref name="TLJ:TVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lank Paze is portrayed by [[Paul Bazely]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']].
